title: GCP Marketplace: ingest entitlement events and map to internal entitlements
author: Ethan Park
description: Context: We already ingest AWS Marketplace entitlement events (see PR #18441) and map AWS product codes -> Redwood entitlements. To support GCP Cloud Marketplace purchases, we need a parallel ingestion path that handles GCP’s event + identifier model, validates the inbound request, and resolves the purchased SKU/add-ons to Redwood internal entitlements used by billing + Console onboarding. What’s in this PR: (1) Adds a GCP Marketplace ingestion endpoint and message handler (supports Pub/Sub push) that accepts procurement events and materializes/updates MarketplaceEntitlement(provider=gcp) records; (2) Adds SKU mapping for GCP product/resource identifiers -> internal entitlement IDs (Hosted/Dedicated/Private + add-ons) using the same entitlement mapping registry used by AWS, with provider-specific keys; (3) Implements idempotency and replay-safe writes (dedupe key derived from GCP messageId + entitlement name) and adds retryable fetch logic for cases where the event arrives before the entitlement is queryable via the Procurement API; (4) Adds request validation for Pub/Sub push using OIDC JWT verification (audience bound to our configured URL) and logs validation failures to audit logs; (5) Documents provider differences in code comments + inline docs: AWS sends customerIdentifier + productCode and uses SNS/SQS; GCP sends entitlement resource names and requires an API lookup to resolve account/buyer context, plus Pub/Sub push auth; (6) Adds fixtures + integration tests for GCP flows mirroring the AWS test harness to ensure deterministic retries and mapping behavior. Provider differences worth calling out: AWS events contain enough data to map SKU directly; GCP events frequently require a follow-up call to the Partner Procurement API to fetch entitlement details and line items; GCP ‘account’ identifiers do not match our notion of Redwood org and must be linked during onboarding (Console wizard will handle this in ENG-4403); GCP event delivery is Pub/Sub push and must be authenticated (we verify JWT and restrict audience). Rollout plan: gated behind feature flag marketplace.gcp_ingest_enabled (default off); staging enabled after merge; prod enablement after partner validation. Out of scope: Console org-linking UX (ENG-4403), pricing page/docs updates (ENG-4405), and final SKU catalog sign-off (PM-873).
commits: marketplace/gcp: add Pub/Sub push handler + request auth verification
marketplace/gcp: implement entitlement fetch/normalize via Procurement API client
marketplace: extend mapping registry to support provider-specific SKU keys
marketplace/gcp: idempotency + replay-safe upserts for entitlement records
tests: add GCP fixtures + integration tests for mapping/retry semantics
docs/comments: note GCP vs AWS differences and operational knobs
review_conversation: Cole Summers: Mapping keys — can we confirm what identifier we’re using for the GCP SKU? On AWS we key off productCode; on GCP I’m seeing both a product resource name and a plan/offer reference. We need the one that will be stable for billing meters.

Ethan Park (author): Good catch. We key off the entitlement line item ‘product.externalName’ (from Procurement API) because it’s what stays constant across events and matches what Partner team gave us for listing setup. Added comment + renamed field to gcp_external_product_name to avoid confusion.
Marcus Lin: Pub/Sub push validation: please ensure we validate OIDC JWT issuer and audience, not just signature. Also we should avoid logging raw JWTs on failure.

Ethan Park (author): Updated verify logic to enforce iss=https://accounts.google.com (and accounts.google.com) plus aud==MARKETPLACE_GCP_PUBSUB_AUDIENCE, and scrubbed Authorization header from logs. Added audit event ‘marketplace.gcp.webhook_rejected’ with reason codes only.

Rafael Mendes: Retry/backoff: what’s the max time we’ll wait before marking an event as failed? We need something observable + an alertable failure counter. Also please ensure idempotency works across retries.

Ethan Park (author): Added bounded exponential backoff (max 6 attempts over ~7 min). If still not resolvable, we store status=needs_review and emit metric marketplace_gcp_entitlement_fetch_failures_total. Idempotency key uses messageId+entitlementName so retries won’t duplicate records. Metrics wiring to dashboards will be in PR #18490.

Chloe Martin: For Console onboarding, we’ll need a clear ‘entitlement present but org not linked’ state. Can we store buyer account id and entitlement display name in the record so the UI can show it?

Ethan Park (author): Added fields gcp_account_id and gcp_entitlement_display_name to the MarketplaceEntitlement model and included in normalized payload. Also added a note in comments that org-linking happens later (ENG-4403).
Nadia Rahman: Tests: can we add a fixture for the ‘region mismatch’/invalid region scenario so we don’t regress? We’ve seen this in early partner validation.

Ethan Park (author): Added a failing entitlement fetch fixture that simulates invalid location metadata and verifies we surface status=needs_review + the correct error code (without leaking request payload). Linked SUP-18461 in the PR for traceability.
release_notes: Adds GCP Cloud Marketplace entitlement ingestion (Pub/Sub push) and mapping of GCP SKUs to internal entitlements behind feature flag marketplace.gcp_ingest_enabled.
merge_summary: Merged via squash; feature flag off by default; staging enablement planned after partner validation; follow-ups: metrics dashboards/alerts (PR #18490) and Console org-linking UX (ENG-4403).
